content: Ba bilaa Piɛrbaa-ba‑i
Piɛr baa Nsãa‑i baŋ waa ta ba piiye baa nuɔmba‑i, *Diilojigãntaamba‑i baa *Diilodubuɔ sorosibaa-ba yuntieŋo‑i, a naara *Sadusĩɛbaa-ba jo ji da-ba.
Piɛrbaa-ba taa ba piiye baa nuɔmba‑i wuɔ Yesu kuu aa sire, kɛrɛ yiiŋgu dii baa yiiŋgu kuomba ka bi sire fuɔ temma‑i. Baŋ juɔ ji da ba piiye dumaaŋo-na, ku saa dɔlnu-bɛi.
Baa bel-ba. Bãaŋgu naa tĩ tĩ. Baa kã ka dii-ba kaso ba cɔ.
Baŋ fiɛ bel-ba, baŋ hii piiye baa bamaŋ hiere, ba fɔ̃ŋgũɔ baa hũu-ma. Bamaŋ naa hũyãa-ma, ba gbãa yu nuɔmba neifieŋa hãi nuɔsiba ndii temma.
Ku cuo kaala‑i-na, *Yuifu ba yuntaamba‑i baa nelle bĩncuɔmba‑i, a naara *ãnjĩnamma pigãataamba‑i, baa jãnu ba-naa *Yerusalɛmu‑i-na.
*Diilojigãntaamba yuntieŋo maŋ ba naŋ bĩŋ-yoŋ Ani‑i, u waa baa u dumɛlleŋ-baamba‑i hiere, a naara Kayifu, baa Nsãa, baa Alɛsãndire.
Baŋ jãanu ba-naa, baa ce ba jo baa Piɛrbaa-ba‑i. Baŋ juɔ, baa yuu-ba wuɔ: «Namaa hilaa baa hiŋ daama‑i hie a ji sire naacolŋ daayo‑i? Hai moloŋo‑i puɔraa-na?»
Huɔŋgu faŋgu-na, *Diiloŋ-Yalle naa yu Piɛr huɔŋga‑i, wuɔ cira: «Nelle yuntaaŋ namaa, baa bĩncuɔŋ namaa,
i ciɛ ãnfafamma molo-na aa na bĩ-ye ji ta na yuu-ye iŋ ciɛ dumaa sire-yuɔ u murgusĩnni-na, dumɛi sĩ wɛi?

Nelma diei dii na saaya na suɔ-ma hiere baa *Isirahɛl-baamba‑i: Naŋ gbuu Nasarɛtitaaŋ Yesu maŋ *daaŋgu-na ko-yo aa Diiloŋo sire-yuɔ, fuɔ barguɔ yaa nuɔ‑i naacolŋ daayoŋ siire yeryer na yufelle-na dumandɛ‑i.
Ba waaŋ Yesu fuɔ maama yaa Diiloŋ-nelma-na wuɔ:
Yesu yaa gbãa kor nelbiliemba‑i u diei yoŋ. Da ma hel ufaŋo-na, Diiloŋo saa hã-ye moloŋo yaŋga naŋga umaŋ gbãa kor-e.»
Piɛrbaa-baŋ daa holle‑i piiye dumaa, kuɔ cu ãndacetaamba hɔmmu‑i. Da ba ne, ba da-ba nelgbãŋgbãlãamba; ba sa suɔ sɛbɛ. Baa pãŋ suɔ wuɔ Yesu wuɔrataamba.
Da ba ne naacolŋo maŋ siire ba caaŋgu-na, ba siɛ suɔ baŋ ka waŋ mamaŋ.
Baa ce ba hiel Piɛrbaa-ba‑i gɔ̃ŋgũɔŋ-nu aa naa yuu ba-naa wuɔ:
«I ka ce-ba niɛ? Nuɔmba‑i hiere Yerusalɛmu‑i-na ba suyaa wuɔ ba yaa siire naacolŋ daayo‑i, nuharuŋgu si dii-mɛi; i siɛ bi gbãa ju-ma.
Ŋga diɛ i sa taara nel daama gbuo nelle‑i hiere, i saaya i gboya-bɛi wuɔ ba baa yaŋ i tiraa nu ba bĩɛ Yesu yerre‑i baa moloŋo. Umaŋ duɔ bĩ-de, kumaŋ da ku waa, u ka da-ku.»
Baŋ juɔ da ba-naa tĩ, baa bĩ Piɛrbaa-ba‑i a ji waŋ baa-ba wuɔ ba baa yaŋ ba tiraa nu ba bĩɛ Yesu yerre‑i ba nunni-na, ba baa bi waŋ u maama baa moloŋo.
Piɛrbaa baa gbɛ̃-ba wuɔ: «Namaa fɛrɛ‑i niɛ-kuŋ na ne! I ce namaa maama yaa‑i aa yaŋ Diiloŋ-maama‑i wɛi?
Miɛ fuɔ, iŋ nuɔ mamaŋ, aa da mamaŋ, i siɛ gbãa fĩinaŋ-mɛi.»
Baŋ siire naacolŋo‑i, kuɔ gbuu dɔlnu nuɔmba‑i, baa ta ba gbɛliɛŋ Diiloŋo‑i, a ce dumaaŋo-na ãndacetaamba saa da nelma da ba cãl-ba; baa naa ba sĩɛl ba yufieŋa yaa piiye baa-ba aa nanna-bɛi ba kã.
Baŋ siire naacolŋo maŋ, u bieŋa naa cor bieŋ komuɔŋa hãi.
Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba cãarã Diiloŋo‑i
Baŋ naana Piɛr‑i baa Nsãa‑i, baa ta kã ba nabaamba wulaa. *Diilojigãntaamba yuntaamba‑i baa bĩncuɔmbaŋ waaŋ mamaŋ baa-ba hiere, baa tũnu ba nabaamba‑i baa-ma.
Baŋ tũɔnu-bɛi dumaaŋo-na, baa gbonu cãrã Diiloŋo‑i wuɔ: «Itie, nuɔnɛi hielaa dɔrɔ‑i baa hĩɛma‑i, baa dãmmaŋ-nuoraaŋgu‑i. Aa bi hiel ni huɔya-niini‑i hiere.
Nuɔnɛi ciɛ ŋ *Yalle dii nel daama‑i i bĩncɔiŋo‑i *Davidi
nuŋgu-na u waŋ-ma wuɔ:

content.text: ‹Bige‑i ciɛ nuɔmba sire ta ba pepiena nilɛiŋa-na?
Ba saa suɔ wuɔ baŋ puu mamaŋ, ma siɛ kã terieŋgu wɛi?
aa yuntaamba pũulã Itieŋo‑i baa u Yufelleŋ-Nolŋo‑i.›

content: Ninsie ninsie, *Erɔdi‑i baa *Pɔ̃se-Pilati‑i a naara *niɛraamba‑i baa *Isirahɛl-baamba‑i hiere, ba tigiiŋ ba-naa nel daade
yaa nuɔ‑i, a pũulã ŋ cãarãŋo‑i Yesu‑i. Ba tigiiŋ ba-naa a pũulã ŋ Yufelleŋ-Nolŋo‑i.
Dumandɛ‑i-na, niŋ ŋa naa pu mamaŋ, mamaŋ waa ŋ huɔŋga-na, ba ciɛ ma yaa‑i.
Fiɛfiɛ‑i-na, Itie, ŋ daa baŋ wur ŋ cãarãaŋ miɛŋo‑i dumaa. Hã-ye holle i tiɛ gbã i waŋ ŋ nelma‑i.
Kãyã-yiɛ i tiɛ gbã i sire jaamba‑i aa bi tiɛ ce nelma bɔi baa gbɛrɛ-wɛima bɔi ŋ cãarãŋo‑i Yesu yerre-na.»
Baŋ juɔ cãrã Diiloŋo‑i tĩ, hĩɛŋ maa sagalla baŋ waa tigiiŋ kusuɔŋ-nu. Diiloŋ-Yalle pãŋ yu ba hɔmmu‑i hiere. Baa da holle ta ba waŋ Diiloŋ-nelma‑i.
Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baambaŋ bilaa ba-naa dumaa
Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba‑i baa ba ciinumma‑i hiere baa naa gbuu bel ba-naa fafamma. Ba hɔlma-na, ŋ siɛ gbãa suɔ wuɔ mɛl kũŋgu‑i daaku‑i aa mɛl kũŋgu‑i daaku‑i.
Himma naŋ temma waa Yesu *pɔpuɔrbiemba ãncemma-na ta ma pigãaŋ wuɔ Yesu siire kelkel. Diiloŋo naa silaa tuɔ ce baa-ba u cor.

Sonniŋ waa baa bamaŋ hiere, baa cĩnniŋ bi waa baa bamaŋ, ba taa ba suor-ni ba jo ba hã Yesu pɔpuɔrbiemba‑i baa ni gbeiŋa‑i. Bafaŋ da ba hũu-ya, ba ne ba gbeiŋ-maamaŋ jĩɛnya ma-naa dumaa aa bi hɔnu-yɛi dumɛi. A ce dumaaŋo-na sũntie saa waa ba hɔlma-na.
Unaŋo waa ba hɔlma-na, ba taa ba bĩ-yo Yosɛfu. U waa *Levitiyiɛŋo. U taa u hel Sipire. Pɔpuɔrbiemba taa ba bĩ-yo Barnabasi, ku yuŋgu yaa wuɔ Sirɛintieŋo.
Suoŋgu naŋgu waa baa-yo, wuɔ suor-ku aa naa jo baa ku gbeiŋa‑i ji hã pɔpuɔrbiemba‑i baa-ya.

footnotes.text: Ku birii a saanu baa cerma. Girɛkimma-na ba naaraaya Davidi yerre-na wuɔ Diiloŋ-cãarãŋo.
